report_name: Falcon Ransomware Claims Attack on Law Firm Weitz & Luxenberg

threat_actors.name: Falcon
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that has claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against the U.S. national law firm Weitz & Luxenberg, utilizing a double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Falcon ransomware payload was deployed to encrypt files on the network of Weitz & Luxenberg as part of a double-extortion attack.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The Falcon group likely exfiltrated large volumes of sensitive data to a cloud storage provider before deploying ransomware, consistent with a double-extortion tactic.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers likely used tools such as vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, hindering system recovery from local backups.

malware.name: Falcon Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Falcon group to encrypt victim files and disrupt operations at Weitz & Luxenberg.

identities.name: Weitz & Luxenberg
identities.description: A U.S. national law firm targeted by the Falcon ransomware group.

indicators.name: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via VSSAdmin
indicators.pattern:
title: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via VSSAdmin
id: 2b8a6039-81b2-4d39-8566-75857e3a111a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-falcon-hits-weitz-and-luxenberg/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to prevent recovery.

indicators.name: Falcon Ransomware Note Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Falcon Ransomware Note Creation
id: 9c3d5e8f-1a2b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a ransom note file named 'RANSOM_NOTE.txt', which is indicative of a ransomware infection like Falcon.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-falcon-hits-weitz-and-luxenberg/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\RANSOM_NOTE.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the 'RANSOM_NOTE.txt' file, a strong indicator of a ransomware attack.

indicators.name: Potential Data Exfiltration to Cloud Storage Services
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Data Exfiltration to Cloud Storage Services
id: 5a4b3c2d-1e9f-4a8b-9c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects DNS queries to common cloud storage providers like Mega.nz or Dropbox, which could indicate pre-ransomware data exfiltration. This rule may generate false positives in environments where these services are used legitimately.'
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-falcon-hits-weitz-and-luxenberg/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-25
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - '.mega.nz'
      - '.dropbox.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic patterns consistent with large data uploads to cloud storage services, a common precursor to double-extortion ransomware attacks.
